title: How to Plan a Santorini Wedding Step by Step
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW step-by-step planning guide (not a refresh, not a venue list). Model: content/posts/wedding-in-crete (planning guide) and content/posts/paros-wedding-venues (legal section). Steps lead; venues appear as 4 to 6 short examples only, each verified by a live read of its own official site saying it hosts weddings. No prices or fees.

OVERLAP: the live old page /7-must-see-santorini-destination-wedding-venues (targets 'santorini wedding venues', ranks #58-#82) and the Greece hub /destinations/europe/greece. SEO checks rankings for 'santorini wedding' and variants (getting married in santorini, santorini wedding planning, santorini wedding venues, santorini wedding cost, santorini wedding packages). The old venues page is linked once; venue-list intent stays with the venue guides. /venue/rocabella-santorini-hotel-spa is NOT linked (its domain is for sale). Run report recommends the split.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; 'on its own site', 'in its own words', 'does not publish' as our search; page dates as source talk; myths). 'Often told' at most once. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section ('as at November 2026'). Source gaps go in the run report only. No 'best' ranking claims and no best month stated as fact.

Steps (brief finalises): 1 decide legal or symbolic and where the legal step happens; 2 pick your season (official weather data labelled by station; Smartraveller heat, wildfire, wind); 3 choose the setting and venue type (caldera, beach, estate or winery, hotel, private villa) with 4 to 6 venue examples; 4 size the guest list against capacity and rooms ('Not published' where blank); 5 plan guest travel (airport and port from official sources; step-free access and transfers as questions, no claims); 6 gather documents (CNI, apostille, translation; Embassy Athens and Smartraveller; Municipality of Thira civil marriage steps only if an official page is read live, else 'check with the municipality and the embassy, including any fees'); 7 lock in house rules in writing as questions; 8 plan the weekend (welcome and recovery events as ideas, no supplier names); 9 booking checklist; FAQ. Cost: a short 'what shapes the cost' paragraph with no figures only if SEO shows cost intent, linking the packages guide.

Sources: venues' official sites, Municipality of Thira official site, visitgreece.gr, the airport's official site, hnms.gr, Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking sites, review sites or Wikipedia.

Speed: Apify web-fetch and DataForSEO. 3 parallel batches (A: venues, fact_01+; B: legal, fact_100+; C: practical: airport, port, weather, Smartraveller, fact_200+), 15 min HARD by the clock, save after every 3 facts, scratch folders san_a..san_c; never retry a declined call.
Images: placeholders only; never AI for a venue, destination or wedding; competitor images reference-only.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.

Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; nothing on legal, church or religious paperwork; no transfer arrangements; no Wedded Privileges.
Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed as examples, no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
